question: What minimum off-roadway sizes does Table 9A-1 give for a STOP sign, a YIELD sign, and a Crossbuck sign on a bicycle facility?
model_answer: Direct Answer: Table 9A-1 (Bicycle Facility Sign and Plaque Minimum Sizes) gives an off-roadway minimum of 18 x 18 inches for the STOP (R1-1) sign, 18 x 18 x 18 inches for the YIELD (R1-2) sign, and 24 x 4.5 inches for the Grade Crossing (Crossbuck) (R15-1) sign. These minimums apply only to signs installed specifically for bicyclist applications on bicycle-only facilities and shared-use paths. Standards (mandatory): - "The minimum sign and plaque sizes for signs specific to bicycle-only facilities and shared-use paths shall be those shown in Table 9A-1. These sizes shall be used only for signs and plaques installed specifically for bicyclist applications." - "The minimum TTC sign and plaque sizes for shared-use paths shall conform to those shown in Table 9A-1." - Table 9A-1 entries (Off Roadway column): "Stop R1-1 9B.01 18 x 18"; "Yield R1-2 9B.01 18 x 18 x 18"; Grade Crossing (Crossbuck) R15-1 — 24 x 4.5. Visual evidence: [Image 4] shows Table 9A-1 (Sheet 1 of 3) listing Stop (R1-1) with an Off Roadway size of 18 x 18, Yield (R1-2) with 18 x 18 x 18, and Grade Crossing (Crossbuck) (R15-1) with an Off Roadway size of 24 x 4.5 (Roadway 48 x 9). [Image 2] shows Figure 9B-1 (Sheet 1 of 2) depicting the R1-1 STOP and R1-2 YIELD signs for bicycle facilities. [Image 3] shows Figure 9B-1 (Sheet 2 of 2) depicting the R15-1 RAILROAD CROSSING Crossbuck sign for bicycle facilities. Citations: - Section 9A.02 Standard §10 (p.1048) - Section 6N.04 Standard §19 (p.844) - Section 9A.03 Guidance §3 (p.1051) - Table 9A-1 (p.1036) - Page 1093
gold_answer: STOP: 18 x 18 inches; YIELD: 18 x 18 x 18 inches; Crossbuck: 24 x 4.5 inches.
